messages.subject: STANDARDS review done
messages.body: Reviewed PR #28206 against AGENTS.md, STYLEGUIDE and i18n conventions after a blind-fix expectation, which the diff matched. Found no Critical or Required issues: one Optional (new string only in en.json), two Nits (repeated title block, English-only git message match) and FYIs. Nothing left.

messages.subject: Spec review done: PR #28206 complies
messages.body: Reviewed PR #28206 against issue #28164 and wrote the report, blind expectation first. The diff implements the issue's 'offer Force Delete' branch: it detects git's submodule refusal and shows a Force Delete toast, with no scope creep. Only a Nit remains: the new i18n key is in en.json only, and I did not read or run the real-git test body.

messages.subject: Test-adequacy review done
messages.body: Statically mapped each claim of PR #28206 to its test: the classifier, toast copy and real-Git message match are guarded by named tests, while the already-forced test, force-removal step, en.json key and other locales are unguarded or weak. Findings are one Nit, two Optional and two FYI; the main FYI is that no test drives the real caller, which passes force:true, so the UI offer is unverified. Nothing was run or reverted and no checkout files changed.

messages.subject: Security lens review done
messages.body: Reviewed PR #28206 as a destructive-path change; the diff only adds a 'submodules' force reason to the classifier plus toast copy, with no new delete path and the lock check intact. Two Required findings: the submodule branch precedes 'dirty', so a checkout with submodules and uncommitted work shows copy that never mentions the uncommitted loss under --force; plus locale/spoofable-substring matching and the Always-force-delete opt-in as Optional/FYI. Nothing is left except the coordinator's triage; no repo files were modified.
